title: Solo dev using AI for a Body Horror Deckbuilder. Hit v0.9.1 and need gameplay feedback!
author: Capital_Champion2998
selftext:
Hey everyone!

I’m working on **Ash Reapers**, a dark fantasy deckbuilder roguelike playable directly in your browser on [Itch.io](http://Itch.io) (or downloadable but not tested on windows, only on linux /android).

The core hook: Your character decays, and you have to defeat enemies to **graft their organs** into 13 different body slots to survive, unlock synergies, and trigger powerful class strategies. The game currently features 260+ cards and 67 relics.

**Language support & Polish:**  
The game is **fully playable in both English and French**. While AI helped with the initial framework, the localization is undergoing a continuous manual proofreading and refining process to ensure  immersive text for both languages (So it is still in process).

**Where the project stands:**  
I’ve just rolled out the **0.9.1 update**, which adds a deep Forge system to fuse cards and customize your deck. Because the systems are quite deep, **I am currently building an interactive tutorial** that will go live very soon to smooth out the learning curve.

Before launching the tutorial and the final version, I really need some raw feedback on the gameplay loop itself.

* **Playable instantly in-browser (Or download):** [https://thing-77.itch.io/ash-reapers](https://thing-77.itch.io/ash-reapers)

**What I'm looking for:**  
Since I used AI tools to help shape the asset-heavy parts of this dark universe, I could really use your expert eyes on:

1. Is the Forge mechanic intuitive enough right now?
2. Does the "organ grafting" system make sense when you look at the UI?
3. Any major balance issues you notice in your first few runs?

Thanks a ton to anyone who takes 10 minutes to try it out. Feel free to roast the balance, I need it to make the game better!
